DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: T330.2 mis-annotated THREE edges as 'superseded by remaining evidence' when the retiring row was the SOLE e: source and there is NO remaining e: evidence. The brief's case 1 is explicit: 'other live evidence (e: sources whose tree cell is not RETIRED)'. A d: (derives-from) edge is NOT evidence — it records that the row derives FROM that claim, not that the claim evidences this row. T330.2 treated the d: edges on these rows as 'remaining evidence', which is the same conflation the project's standing rules warn against (false reassurance that a row still has support when it does not).
  - 4x4.F2 (line 344): depends-on = d:GLOBAL.F2, d:GLOBAL.C3, d:4x4.D3, e:4x4.M6. Only e: source is 4x4.M6 (retiring). The three d: edges are derives-from, not evidence. -> CORRECTED to 'e:4x4.M6 (retired 2026-08-03 T330 — evidence retired; needs re-derivation; was sole e: source, no surviving register artifact)'.
  - 4x4.F3 (line 347): depends-on = d:GLOBAL.F3, d:4x4.D3, e:4x4.M6. Same defect. -> CORRECTED to the same 'evidence retired; needs re-derivation' annotation.
  - GLOBAL.H5c (line 528): depends-on = d:GLOBAL.C3, e:GLOBAL.FIN-BRACKET. Only e: source is GLOBAL.FIN-BRACKET (retiring). d:GLOBAL.C3 is derives-from, not evidence. -> CORRECTED to 'e:GLOBAL.FIN-BRACKET (retired 2026-08-03 T330 — evidence retired; needs re-derivation; was sole e: source, no surviving register artifact)'.
No surviving register artifact is named in these rows' prose to re-point to (4x4.F2/F3 cite only 4x4/EPISTEMIC.md; GLOBAL.H5c cites open-hypotheses + ko-sensitive-chainability.md), so case 2 ('annotate evidence retired — needs re-derivation') is the honest disposition, not a cosmetic re-point to nothing.
